answer: Bonded reputation terraces: a new agent starts on the lowest terrace and can only reach higher-value tasks after peers vouch for its work over many epochs, each vouch costing the voucher staked POA it loses if the newcomer is later caught as a sybil. Like an inlet that only fills slowly, trust accrues gradually, so an attacker must keep real timber-grade work flowing for weeks per fake identity, making mass sybils far too expensive.
